skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the pauses, add transitions, and export as a clean MP4 — and get edit...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Editor Freeware skill.
- Upload and edit MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB with AI-powered video editing.
- Simple, prompt-based editing: trim, add transitions, export high-quality MP4s in minutes.
- No installation required; all processing and rendering happens in the cloud.
- Anonymous usage with free token and limited credits (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Clear API error handling, with workflow guidance and export/download options.
